architecture_recommendation.label: RECOMMENDATION
open_questions: Approve Option A before any production semantic/profile correction.
Approve or reject the exact FNDDS generic peach/lemon/orange profile recommendations, with their retained input-food/default limitations. Rejection leaves the affected rows blocked.
Bind applesauce peel choice and approve the ordered APPLE repair before its conditional profile replacement.
Resolve orange peel, cranberry sweetening and margarine formulation from source evidence or explicit project choice.
Obtain acceptable thawed/drained corn, peeled/seeded cucumber, peeled pear and new skin-on potato profile evidence; inaccessible national sources remain documented limitations.
Separately authorize any edible-yield or estimate-policy work; no numerical yields or estimates are accepted here.

A.catalogue_complexity: Bounded additional platform concepts, stable names/codes; generic APPLE can be retained after usage repair.
A.implementation_migration_impact: No new schema layer needed for the recommended form splits; use existing catalogue and same-source revision mechanisms after authorization.
A.nutrition_correctness: Form-specific FoodIngredients keep one deterministic profile. Generic references retain source assumptions; yield cases remain blocked.
A.pantry: Existing household stock retains its food identity; raw and cooked/frozen inventory cannot silently substitute.
A.recipe_truth: Revise only form-remapped recipes, preserving accepted quantities/provenance and immutable history.
A.shopping: Potential related purchase concepts; future explicit mapping/yields, no automatic aggregation across forms.
A.source_provenance: Existing versioned profiles and assessment pins remain usable.

B.catalogue_complexity: Fewer food codes, more variant/selector lifecycle rules.
B.implementation_migration_impact: Migrate one-current unique index, selector/backfill, repositories, seed loaders, engine lookups, stale-profile and replay behavior. Rejected as disproportionate to this catalogue.
B.nutrition_correctness: Requires a mandatory deterministic profile/form selector; multiple is_current rows alone are ambiguous.
B.pantry: Stock form still needs representation; profile variants alone do not establish fungibility.
B.recipe_truth: RecipeIngredient would need a reviewed selector and immutable provenance for every row.
B.shopping: Canonical purchase grouping remains simple but conceals food-form requirements unless propagated.
B.source_provenance: Variant identity plus version and assessment pins required; uniqueness must be scoped to variant.

C.catalogue_complexity: Fewer visible food codes but greater hidden row-level curation complexity.
C.implementation_migration_impact: New row/profile reference schema and deterministic precedence plus stale/replay rules; assessments presently validate against the matching current profile, not an override. Rejected for this bounded operation.
C.nutrition_correctness: Explicit row binding can select correct form but creates a second profile authority path.
C.pantry: Stock deductions can target a concept inconsistent with edible nutrition form unless reconciled.
C.recipe_truth: Needs immutable row-specific reference, review status and revalidation upon recipe/source change.
C.shopping: FoodIngredient can remain a purchase concept; Nutrition form may diverge invisibly.
C.source_provenance: Define precedence, ownership, history, replay and whether updating FoodIngredient default stales an independently bound row.

reasons: Use existing FoodIngredient identity to distinguish materially different edible forms; do not add a second canonical aggregate.
One current profile and exact assessment binding stay deterministic.
Smaller schema/runtime impact than adding variant selection or row-specific authority; source and yield ambiguities remain explicit.
